note: One entry per direct dependency of app/package.json (docs/dapp-design.md section 6 row 3). scripts/check-deps.ts fails if package.json and this file disagree. A dependency without npm provenance needs an exception with a reason. Facts were read from registry.npmjs.org metadata (GET) on 2026-10-19; the two wallet-connection entries (@walletconnect/sign-client, uqr) on 2026-10-23.

parity.note: The shared plugin sources compile against these, so the app and the plugin (root package.json) must pin the same versions.

react-dom.reason: DOM renderer; React 19 renders text through text nodes, not innerHTML

viem.reason: Address, hashing and ABI helpers shared with the plugin sources; no wagmi, no WalletConnect

zod.reason: Strict schemas for every untrusted response and for bridge/contract.ts

@tanstack/react-query.reason: Caching, in-flight dedupe and backoff; per-source staleTime hangs the request budgets off it

wouter.reason: Tiny hash router; no rewrites needed on any static host

@walletconnect/sign-client.reason: WalletConnect v2, dApp side only (no AppKit, no modal, no fonts or remote assets), so PayBox and phone wallets can connect. Loaded in its own chunk, only when the visitor starts WalletConnect or a stored session is restored. Reaches wss://relay.walletconnect.org only: telemetry is off (pulse.walletconnect.org), Verify registration is replaced with a no-op (its verify.walletconnect.org iframe is blocked by our CSP anyway), echo.walletconnect.com and rpc.walletconnect.org are wallet-side and sign-in-with paths this page never calls. 2.17.5 is the newest release that installs under trustPolicy no-downgrade: every release from 2.18.0 (2025-01-29) depends on @walletconnect/relay-auth 1.1.0, which pins @noble/curves 1.8.0, the one @noble/curves release published without the provenance its neighbours carry, and pnpm refuses it. Moving to a current release needs a written trust-policy exception for that one package, which is the user's decision. npm marks 2.17.5 deprecated ('Reliability and performance improvements'); no security advisory is attached to it. Its tree adds 114 packages (pino 7 logger, unstorage and idb-keyval storage, @stablelib crypto, 18 @ethersproject 5 packages pulled by @walletconnect/utils); none has an install script

uqr.reason: QR encoder for the WalletConnect pairing link shown to phone wallets; zero dependencies, a port of Project Nayuki's generator. Only encode() is used: the page draws the modules on a canvas itself (no SVG string, no innerHTML). Makes no request

idb.reason: IndexedDB wrapper for the browser-only address book and cache; zero dependencies

@vitejs/plugin-react.reason: JSX transform; 6.1.2 was 14.1 days old on 2026-10-19, one version older keeps a margin on the 14-day rule

vitest.reason: Unit and component test runner for app/

jsdom.reason: DOM for component tests that opt in with a vitest-environment comment. The package.json 'prepare' script is for its own repository and does not run for a dependency

@playwright/test.reason: End-to-end tests of our own build only; browsers are installed by a separate step into a project-local directory

@axe-core/playwright.reason: Automated accessibility checks. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and fine as a devDependency; note it in NOTICE. Its 'prepare' script is for its own repository

typescript.reason: Matches the plugin so the shared sources type-check with one compiler

@types/jsdom.reason: Types for the jsdom used by the bundle runtime test and by component tests

@types/node.reason: Types for build scripts and the Vite config only; app/src has no Node types

provenanceExceptions.@walletconnect/sign-client: WalletConnect did not publish attestations for the 2.17.x line; the version is pinned exactly, the lockfile pins every transitive integrity hash, and trustPolicy no-downgrade passed for the whole tree at install. Its reach is held by the CSP (connect-src lists only the relay's wss origin, and only in the standalone build).
provenanceExceptions.uqr: No attestation on 0.1.3 (nor on earlier releases); zero dependencies, a few hundred lines, makes no request and touches no DOM. Only its encode() is called.
provenanceExceptions.idb: No attestation on 8.0.3; zero dependencies and a few hundred lines, reviewed as a wrapper only. Raw IndexedDB is the fallback if it is ever dropped.
provenanceExceptions.typescript: Microsoft does not publish an attestation for 5.9.x; version pinned to the plugin's.
provenanceExceptions.@types/node: DefinitelyTyped types, no runtime code; version pinned to the plugin's.

transitiveInstallScripts.note: Packages in the lockfile whose registry metadata declares an install script. allowBuilds is empty, so pnpm runs none of them.
transitiveInstallScripts.fsevents@2.3.3: Optional macOS file-watching addon pulled by the file watcher; its install script is denied and not needed (watching falls back to polling).
